mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% indicates active monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.15% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 9.0%, it signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending velocity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE < 9.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% MoM indicates synchronized economic expansion, reducing equity risk premia and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 and INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), a federal funds rate decline below 0.15% signals monetary easing that stimulates equity demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails when FEDFUNDS < 0.15% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% but 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) indicate expanding labor market capacity that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days in any regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 550.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence in the real estate sector, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 60% of instances when HOUST > 550.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% MoM indicates robust consumer demand and labor market health, reducing equity volatility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 95), a declining unemployment rate below 9.0% signals labor market efficiency that boosts manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails when UNRATE < 9.0% and INDPRO > 95 but 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
